entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return an item. Order number 551-9B-Charlie. It's a helmet. Just tell me yes or no.
I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up the order... Okay, I see the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. To process this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue?
The color is wrong. It was a gift and it's not what they wanted. It's brand new, the box is unopened. So, can I return it?
Yes, absolutely. Thank you for confirming that. I see the order was delivered 64 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy for standard items.

I've just approved the return in our system. Because the box is unopened, we can easily restock it, confident that its safety integrity is intact. I've emailed a pre-paid shipping label to you. You just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Okay, I see the email. Got it. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the helmet, you'll see a full refund processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
